En Garayalde un muy buen servicio es su YPF. con variedad de desayunos y meriendas, carga de agua caliente, comidas para disfrutar y un pequeño almacén surtido. Duchas y un lindo hotel.
Desde que volvieron a abrir se destaca el servicio. Felicitaciones a empleados y dueños

(Translated by Google)
In Garayalde, the YPF gas station is excellent, offering a variety of breakfasts and snacks, hot water, meals, and a small, well-stocked store. They also have showers and a nice hotel.
Since reopening, the service has been outstanding. Congratulations to the employees and owners!
